messages:
maria: heads-up 14c5 planning sync on packaging. leadership wants a concise set of commitment bands + standardized add-ons for Q2. we need a short ops spec to hand to eng/billing by Fri.
sam: commercial asks: 3 commitment bands (starter, scale, enterprise) + two add-ons (priority-lane, reserved-burst). customers want predictable spend and an easy renewal path. do not require a custom contract for most deals. :money_with_wings:
devin: from eng: prefer per-route throttles + time-windowed reserved capacity rather than opaque "burst" credits. implementation effort: medium. main work is billing dimension and quota enforcement across regions.
rachael: pricing: bands should map to % discount off list token-rate and include an explicit throughput floor. also need rules for partial-month prorates and early-termination credits. i'll model impact once bands are defined.
maria: can we agree on minimal viable scope? proposal:
- 3 bands: Starter (low commit), Scale (mid), Enterprise (high)
- Add-ons: Priority Lane (per-route weight), Reserved Burst (hourly credits capped)
- Migration: auto-convert existing commits into nearest band with opt-out
- Overage: charged at token-rate, or convert to throughput rate if customer purchased Reserved Burst
sam: commercial prefers overage floor tied to band: min_overage = band_rate * 0.1 monthly. reduces bill shock for large bursts.
devin: engineering caveat: "Reserved Burst (hourly credits)" means we need a rolling window counter and capped token bucket per customer. effort estimate: 3 wks core + 1 wk rollout tooling + 1 wk billing export. adds ~0.6 FTE for 2 months.
rachael: also need billing invariants for audits: statements must reconcile tokens -> dollars with <0.2% variance across exports. billing-bot: verified: existing pipeline supports token reconciliation; new per-hour credits will need extension to parquet schema.
maria: can someone draft the ops spec bullet list? keep it short and actionable. includes acceptance criteria.
sam: I'll draft commercial constraints + renewal safety net: no forced migration for renewals in the next 90 days; migration path optional unless customer signs a new higher-band deal.
devin: ops checklist (rough):
```
- quota: per-customer token-bucket with hourly reset for reserved burst
- telemetry: add "reserved_burst_used" metric
- enforcement: route weight override for priority-lane
- billing: add "burst_credits" column and preserve token->dollar mapping
- rollout: dark launch 1% -> canary 10% -> GA
```
rachael: financials request: simulate uplifts if 20% of Scale customers pick Priority Lane. i'll run later today and share.
maria: action items:
- sam: draft commercial + migration guardrails (due Thu noon)
- devin: engineering estimate + required schema changes (due Thu EOD)
- rachael: financial sim and recommended band thresholds (due Thu EOD)
- maria: compile ops spec + acceptance criteria and circulate (due Fri)
billing-bot: created ticket #BILL-4723 to track schema change and export validation.
maria: thanks all 44d will sync if any blockers show up.
